name: Extra Strains
author: Ben
summary: Two more strains to pick before a run: Taxman and Short Fuse.
description:
Two run modifiers for players who find the game's own strains too gentle. Pick them on the Custom strain screen before a run: the arrows by the STRAINS title page over to them.

Taxman (heat 1): every game costs $1 to start (nothing if you are broke). Short Fuse (heat 2): every game, the crumble countdown starts 2 turns in, so the board starts falling that much sooner.

Also the reference example for the Strain Creation API: one strain written with the builder's hooks, one as a StrainBehaviour built on the Crumble Control API. Both libraries install alongside it.
